notes.title: Toxic Crusaders Launching on December 4, 2025!
notes.content: [h3]As announced at San Diego Comic Con this past weekend, we are excited to reveal the launch date for [i]Toxic Crusaders[/i]: [b]December 4th, 2025[/b]![/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Check out the Toxic Crusaders Release Date Trailer here![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FeDPCWurjdE"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]We understand that the change in release date/time has been pushed back multiple times by this point, but we will finally be ready to launch [i]Toxic Crusaders[/i] this December! This new release date also falls in line with the release of the new [i]The Toxic Avenger[/i] movie by Troma and Cineverse![/h3][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/ddd4881269b841fae392ec2df5fe208279bc1977.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]We've been hard at work getting levels in order, fine-tuning enemies and bosses, and ensuring our Tag In/Tag Out System and RAD Mode are functioning as we intend them to. We've also been working on getting new art assets implemented into the game, including new throwable objects, new consumables, and new destructible objects that players can interact with! The game will also have a new player UI that should function completely different than what's currently in the demo.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/bf89a885359889c6521bcbb28232fe90451cd697.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Changes to game release dates are always frustrating, but our priority is releasing [i]Toxic Crusaders[/i] at the level of quality our community deserves and will enjoy.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/d5c0eb9552b67451115a86bd4c5eeeca803925bd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]We thank you for your continued patience as we get [i]Toxic Crusaders[/i] over the finish line![/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Be sure to follow Retroware's developer page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more![/h3][h3][/h3][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Retroware"]Steam Developer: Retroware[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Toxic Crusaders is in the MIX Summer Games Showcase!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/1f200badc808cae89618f2e1cca0fe6085bd045c.jpg[/img]
Toxic Crusaders is in the MIX Summer Game Showcase! And with our featured spotlight, we're excited to reveal some new content that will be in the game when Toxic Crusaders launches in Q3 of 2025!

Check out the Official Gameplay Trailer for Toxic Crusaders here!
https://x.com/Retroware/status/1929958201585209849

Players can look forward to:
[list]
[*] Playing as all the members of the original Toxic Crusaders gang, including Toxie, Nozone, Junkyard, Major Disaster, and Headbanger, along with Toxie's girlfriend, Yvonne, and even Toxie's mom, Mrs. Junko!
[*] New level environments inspired from movies made by Troma--like [i]Class of Nuke 'Em High[/i] and [i]Poultrygeist: Night of the Chicken Dead[/i]!
[*] New bosses--with some also hailing from Troma films, along with the evil Dr. Killemoff and other characters from the original Toxic Crusaders cartoon!
[*] A new "Tag Out" System, where players will be able to SWITCH between different Crusaders when its corresponding meter is full! Players will also be able to cycle through the whole team of Crusaders, so you'll be able to switch into your desired character (that is, unless another player is already using that character)!
[*] A new soundtrack composed by PSYCHOSTICK!
[*] Physical editions of the game will be distributed by Limited Run Games!
[/list]

We're incredibly excited to be continuing development on Toxic Crusaders--scheduled for release in Q3 later this year!

Wishlist Toxic Crusaders and play the demo today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303850/Toxic_Crusaders/
And be sure to follow Retroware's publisher page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more!

notes.title: Defend Tromaville in 4-Player Local Co-op!
notes.content:
Grab up to 3 other players--be they your friends, siblings, neighbors, or your grandma for insane local multiplayer action! With support for local couch co-op, you'll be able to take on the evil Smogulan forces with a party of up to 4 players at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/d5711f3f8795de5d2fbf9e4613be9d5f18a93573.gif[/img]

Choose your favorite Toxic Crusader and jump into the fight across Tromaville and locales beyond! Gang up on bosses, toss around enemies on the streets, or compete to see who can get the highest combo number!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/ba938697c7b0cd9e35fa7898846604f49a316d04.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Defenders of Tromaville, Earth, and...Other Stuff![/b][/h3]
While the original team consisted of Toxie, Nozone, Major Disaster, Junkyard, and Headbanger, we just had to add in Yvonne and, of course, Mrs. Junko (Toxie's mom) for players to choose from!

Play as Toxie, the mop-wielding heroic leader of the Toxic Crusaders!

Choose Yvonne, Toxie's girlfriend with a KILLER singing voice!

Pounce on foes as Junkyard, the lovably vicious dog boy!

Storm onto the battlefield as Major Disaster, the commander of nature!

Fly into the fray as Nozone, the former ace pilot with a devastating sneeze!

Wield the brains and the brawn as Headbanger, the conjoined hero of Dr. Bender and surf boy Fender!

Or bring the pain as Mrs. Junko--Toxie's caring mother!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/7ab58ce15df1e2a600f1265a53496610e12a703f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/6a7b68be55d991bb0fec85e7988b251374d81a52.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/a0a63b8f7e7b908939744dadc38d1ca757e59c6a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/0bb7324691f427f68b89f627a0d4a5881a82241d.png[/img]

You can look forward to grabbing your friends to play local couch co-op in Toxic Crusaders when the game launches later this year!

Stay tuned for even more!

notes.title: Throwing the Game!
notes.content:
You can pick up and throw objects with ease as any member of the Toxic Crusaders! Pick up garbage cans, Grossolium barrels, and more as you clear out Tromaville of its Smogulan invaders!

[h3]Grab OBJECTS like mailboxes, benches, and more that you can find each level to toss at incoming enemies![/h3]
Who says you can't use your environment to beat up baddies? Take full advantage of the level by grabbing stationary objects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/214377c1c6602e99fb1bc2e3183e069a4e80760d.gif[/img]
[h3]Yes, you can throw CARS![/h3]
Don't hesitate to grab a vehicle, either parked or broken down, and smash it onto enemies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/55915d0d28fee650c1da28fe5be04fb49b97d6d2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/713ab8c0ab03b6b0b4136f478587fc4f40016e53.gif[/img]
[h3]And, of course, you can throw ENEMIES![/h3]
What better way to dispose of enemies than to throw 'em down themselves?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/5b852a55a5a970d81a91e55ffb50f35e58c89062.gif[/img]
Now, if only we could throw other players...

Check back for even more as we continue with development!

notes.title: Callbacks to the Original Cartoon!
notes.content:
As the essential successor to the original 90s cartoon, Toxic Crusaders pulls on its origins to bring fans of the original show–and newcomers–a taste of some elements that stood out from the show!

[h3][b]1. Yvonne’s Singing![/b][/h3]
No doubt Yvonne is a talented singer–always lifting the spirits of the team throughout the original cartoon and celebrating with them after a well-fought victory! We just had to include her singing in some capacity in the game, so we decided to make her unquestionable talent her  special attack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/207964e62486f2a4f4349884264f9631dd17798c.png[/img]
[h3][b]2. Apocalypse Attackcopters![/b][/h3]
Dr. Killemoff and his Radiation Rangers descend upon Tromaville in their Apocalypse Attackcopters! Inspired by several scenes in the cartoon, we thought it would be neat to bring back these Smogulan flying machines of...smog! Don't miss them in the opening cutscene of the demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/98140bd1c94deceaf4a49f064a2c42c803199cfb.png[/img]
[h3][b]3. ACHOO![/b][/h3]
Nozone was a huge sneezer back in the original cartoon, so why should he be any different in the game? His all-too-familiar sneezes sent Dr. Killemoff and his Radiation Rangers soaring into the air in cartoon, but now we've contained his sneezes into an AOE attack that can knock down enemies surrounding the former ace pilot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/94e0ea5479319fc83cb4c9f6f08f24a815660d41.png[/img]
[h3][b]4. Home is Where the Junkyard Is![/b][/h3]
In the last section of the demo, vigilant players will be able to spot the tattered makeshift home of the Toxic Crusaders in the background! From its humble beginnings when Toxie founded the team with Nozone and Major Disaster, to its current state in the demo, any fan of the 90s cartoon should easily notice the HQ of the Toxic Crusaders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/94b1716032d3f4dde460c98abce0739bc2983037.png[/img]
[h3][b]5. It's Shape Up (Clean Up) Time![/b][/h3]
Like Yvonne's talent for singing, Toxie's (fully decided upon) catchphrase had to make it into the game (certainly in one form or another!). After deciding on this back in the original cartoon, Toxie's catchphrase can once again be appreciated by fans and newcomers alike!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/a72f87e9b9dd17fa8780e8cdab274774a1a195eb.png[/img]
Look forward to even more as we continue along with development!

Follow Retroware's publisher page to stay up-to-date on all our games, news, and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/retroware

notes.title: Throwin' Down with Polluto!
notes.content:
Dr. Killemoff has once again unleashed Polluto, the Living Oil Slick! This time, however, he’s come with a handful of new abilities! Take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/d5711f3f8795de5d2fbf9e4613be9d5f18a93573.gif[/img]
[h2][b]1. Tail Swipe![/b][/h2]
Unlike his original cartoon appearance, Polluto will now make use of his giant tail! You’ll want to keep back when you see him turn, or else you’ll get whacked in the face with a tail of oily goo! Getting hit by Polluto’s tail will send you flying across the stage–and take a bite out of your health–so keep your distance and attack him AFTER he swings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/d2e59d62c16ba269fb5ac3db3f642d2721bbb61e.gif[/img]
[h2][b]2. Slipping, Sliding, and PUNCHING![/b][/h2]
When Polluto gets knocked down on his oily behind, he’ll assume his Oil Slick Mode, allowing him to move across the stage and away from enemies. After Polluto relocates himself on the stage, he’ll manifest into a giant oily FIST that will knock back any Toxic Crusader hoping to bully him as soon as he reforms into his regular monstrous form!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/3a35c6df4c5218b94e079b34dfdfbaf5be5e32b6.gif[/img]
[h2][b]3. Toxic Radiation Breath![/b][/h2]
Watch out! Polluto can now unleash a devastating Toxic Breath that can deal a great deal of damage to any Toxic Crusader in the way! However, his Toxic Breath will cause a puddle of radiation waste to form where it lands, which, like the Grossolium barrels found on the sides or carried by some Radiation Rangers, can also charge up your Rad Meter if you stand on top of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/1e1d60105ad0909542c11259c48b1350ce7361fb.gif[/img]
Be mindful when pursuing Polluto in his Oil Slick Mode, and stand a good distance away to avoid getting SOCKED in the face! 

Think you’re tough enough to take down Polluto, the Living Oil Slick?!

Play the Toxic Crusaders demo available NOW!

notes.title: “Not Cool, Bug Dudes!”
notes.content:
Not every game is perfect, even for one made for the best team of hideously deformed creatures of superhuman size and strength! Check out some of the most notorious bugs that plagued our QA team during Toxic Crusaders’ development!

[h3][b]1. Runaway Train Sign[/b][/h3]
We don’t know. It just wanted to be a pacifist, I guess.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/c4a3cb5511a9023c20f81fed58e9d77e3c69b582.gif[/img]
Mind you, this bug was replicable no matter which direction the sign was thrown, and regardless of whether it happened to hit an enemy or not!

[h3][b]2. Floating Barrel[/b][/h3]
It’s just floating there…MENACINGLY!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/d965355dd99aeb3b28712a5b500fc690bb2c303f.gif[/img]
Once it was in the air, it stayed up there, like it just didn't care. Even when our testers tried to pick it up, attack it, or throw enemies or other objects into it, that barrel just wouldn’t budge!

[h3][b]3. I Have to Go My Planet Needs Me![/b][/h3]
Outer space do be a popular place. Keep looking at Junkyard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/25d85b0ecccbfec0e028b1cc90a2e2771c5e55c2.gif[/img]
This bug occurred when a player pressed the “Jump” button right before a mid-game cutscene began. Fender’s line makes it all the better.

These were just some of the many bugs found during development! We’re excited to share more with you as we continue working on Toxic Crusaders!

Wishlist the game and play the free demo available now!

notes.title: Giving Life to the Story - Comic Book Cutscenes
notes.content:
Did you know [i]Toxic Crusaders[/i] used to have a comic book series? We wanted to incorporate the spirit of that piece of Toxie history into the game via motion comics!

[h3][b]Concepting Out Comic Cutscenes[/b][/h3]

We wanted to drive the story of the game via comic cutscenes as a direct reference to the original comic runs of the Toxic Crusaders in the early 90s. 

Artist Steve Gregson drew up sketches for all of the motion comics players will be able to see in-game! Check out some of the panels he worked on below, going from concept sketch to final design:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/80c607dbf2268664a1d52fd8dfd05116d5751744.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/1557932da3956f050cf05289b646cf5598c49d13.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/226a724e556ca099ef932fba2eabce529a54e9e0.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Continuing After Many Years–I Mean, Days![/b][/h3]
It’s no question we wanted [i]Toxic Crusaders[/i] to act as “the Season 2 that we never got” from the original cartoon. This was an important fact that we wanted to highlight, so much so that we even have some of the in-game characters–in true 4th wall-breaking fashion–make direct nods to this continuity between the game and the cartoon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/7f85c9d739fcb6551a070a206c2e08f6ccaaf556.png[/img]
[h3][b]Bringing (Back) Personality[/b][/h3]
We’re delighted to be working with TeamFourStar, who are providing all of the voiceover lines for each character! We’ll go into more detail on our team-up with them at a later date, but, for now, it’s comics, in-game comics, and motion comics galore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/f6969df1cb51c7e6b3ebdc59e807f1223731bc10.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/7a6b60e480c0ca1375a8dfef75ce9a4a5e996df7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/a72f87e9b9dd17fa8780e8cdab274774a1a195eb.png[/img]
We’re excited to share more about [i]Toxic Crusaders[/i] as we continue on with development!

Wishlist [i]Toxic Crusaders[/i] and play the free demo available NOW!

notes.title: Toxic Crusaders NOW HAS Live Action Cutscenes??
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings, citizens of Tromaville![/b][/h1]

[h3]Here's update from the Retroware crew about our game Toxic Crusaders!![/h3]

We drove up to the Troma offices in NYC and filmed with the one and only Lloyd Kaufman. Lloyd is the President of Troma (the creators of the Toxic Avenger and the Toxic Crusaders cartoon our game is based on.) Lloyd usually intros all of their movies and shows for their physical releases... so, we thought having Lloyd introduce [i][b]the game[/b][/i] would be really fitting. So, YES, we have live action footage of Lloyd Kaufman IN Toxic Crusaders: The Game!! That is coupled with the motion comic cutscenes and FULL voice acting in the game. [i]Plus... some extra surprises coming soon![/i]

[h2]This footage will be used in the game itself as well as Steam Next Fest this June![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/8c76e81af6e1468d3f1eefe0b4dc2476c8eab65e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/98132a95641799fef2ae10a05da5e7799a8e68c1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/666694bf8d6a5276c593d6693959798c58902ba2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/2664d472c9a7332267567a63b788b1af9fdc7e79.png[/img]

GREAT JOB to our crew that went up to film: Joe La Scola, Xander Arnot, and Justin Silverman.

[h3]And REMEMBER, the game is Lloyd AND Angry Video Game Nerd approved!![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/7e5275c9c91191026c0f81398a339ed3573c6f50.png[/img]

notes.title: Toxic Crusaders PLAYABLE at PAX East 2023!!!
notes.content:
When the evil Dr. Killemoff attacks, only one team of hideously deformed creatures of superhuman size and strength stands between him and his plans for global pollution: the Toxic Crusaders, earth's last, greatest and ugliest hope for survival!

[i][b]And NOW you can play Toxic Crusaders at PAX East 2023 at the Retroware booth!! (#15031)
[/b][/i]

There's also a TON of fun things to do at the booth aside from playing the games...
[list]
[*] TOXIE COSPLAYERS FOR PHOTO OPS
[*] FREE SLIME (STRESS BALL STYLE)
[*] SOUNDTRACK GIVEAWAYS
[*] SIGNINGS FROM FAMOUS YOUTUBERS
[*] UMM... CHECKING OUT A COOL BOOTH!!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/d5f6c8861ff1c5158b76127451521f3709b66b10.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/320ac5a3df819f688132dc59d2f689b1b359b887.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43799837/895ac4f984eaa022cb4523f434968cd7c4f95968.jpg[/img]

[b]GANE FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] The triumphant return of the Toxic Crusaders, just when we needed them most!
[*] Pulse-pounding beat 'em up action for up to four player local co-op
[*] Gorgeous full-color pixel art graphics
[*] A stunning soundtrack that'll make you party like it's 1992
[*] Amazing comic book cutscenes featuring the voices of TeamFourStar (DragonBall Z Abridged)
[*] Seven playable characters, each with their own unique moves and powers
[*] Seven unique stages taking you from the streets of Tromaville to Planet Smogula and beyond!
[*] Surprise cameos (each more surprising than the last) from across the Troma Cinematic Universe!
[/list]
